channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Multiple People, Including 2 Children, Killed in Erie Mass Shooting
item.description: Two women were found dead in the street, two children were killed, and the victim reportedly took their own life in a mass shooting in Erie, Pa.

item.title: Ella Langley Tulsa concert canceled after security threat
item.description: A Friday night concert by Ella Langley in Tulsa, Oklahoma, was canceled following what officials described as a serious security threat.

item.title: Fort Hood survivors react to livestream of Hasan execution
item.description: Alonzo Lunsford, who was shot multiple times, said he plans to attend in person and wants to lock eyes with the shooter, Nidal Hasan.

item.title: The Uplift: Mr. Liberty
item.description: David Beganud profiles a man who has spent nearly his whole life visiting prisons, gaining the experience to help inmates and their families.
